payload.leagueSummary: NET is a knife fight at the top right now: KeithK75, Dan94, and MattF are all living in the top tier, with BigTime crashing the party on a tiny sample. The weird part is the underlying golf actually matches the table for once — Keith and Dan are doing damage in both gross and net, while Matt is surviving on a filthy little cocktail of short game and putting rather than pure ball-striking. The back half is uglier than a three-putt from three feet, with a couple players bleeding strokes across basically everything and one guy turning golf into a humanitarian crisis.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the most complete profiles in the window; they’re not just winning net, they’re also the gross engines everyone else is trying to keep up with.
BigTime’s two-start splash is very approach-heavy: the irons are doing the heavy lifting while the tee game is along for the ride in the back seat.
The bottom end is split between “can’t hit it” and “can’t hit it and can’t putt it,” with derekldavis and Leroy4522 doing enough damage to make the leaderboard look like a crime scene.
